description_expanded: This charming three-story Seagrove Beach vacation home exudes a cheerful atmosphere, boasting four bedrooms that can comfortably accommodate up to a dozen beachgoers. With its serene pale blue exteriors trimmed in white and two columned upper-level verandas, the house embodies a gracious Old Florida-style aesthetic. The verandas overlook a yard adorned with lush Magnolias and bordered by a white picket fence. Located on the Gulf side of Scenic 30A in the Summers Edge community, this rental is just a short stroll from the bright beach and a precious coastal dune lake. This rare natural treasure features artisan spring-fed waters in the lake, connected to the salty gulf by a creek-like estuary that flows back and forth with the tides. This creates a magical mixture of water that supports a diverse array of fish, waterfowl, and wildlife. In addition to the beautiful beach, guests can enjoy fishing on the lake and exploring it by paddleboard or kayak. The community also offers two inviting swimming pools for guests, one of which is seasonally heated. The first floor of Five O'Clock Somewhere features three bedrooms and a cozy den, furnished with two white cloth love seats adorned with colorful pillows, facing a flatscreen TV mounted on a captain's fish cabinet. One guest bedroom includes a regal dark hardwood-framed queen-size bed and a private ensuite with a tub/shower combination. The second bedroom offers a stylish contemporary look with a black metal-framed queen-size bed and its own ensuite with a walk-in shower. The remaining guest quarters on this level consist of a bright white bunk room that sleeps six, with direct access to a bath featuring a tub/shower combination, which also serves as a powder room off the den. The open living, dining, and kitchen area is on the second floor, with access to a comfortably furnished veranda where you can enjoy drinks among the Magnolia treetops. The living area features a laid-back coastal style, with two white tropical slip-covered couches, a love seat, and a unique natural wicker armchair. These pieces encircle a large square dark leather ottoman that can hold a cocktail tray and face a large flatscreen TV mounted on a handsome rich hardwood cabinet for entertainment. A sunny alcove near the corner windows at the foot of the staircase includes two tropical straw-woven cushioned chairs and a plush blue bench. Decorative art throughout the home includes seascape paintings, nautical accents, driftwood pieces, stylish mirrors, and abstract art. Honey-toned hardwood flooring flows from the living area into the charming country-style kitchen and dining area. An oval hardwood dining table is flanked by benches on each side and accompanied by antique white-washed ladder-back chairs with woven straw seats. Nearby, a row of windows features royal blue cushioned seating that spans its width. The open kitchen includes an entertainment bar with three teal-colored vintage modern stools, brushed stainless steel appliances, gleaming black granite countertops, creamy white beadboard cabinetry, and a cocoa-colored brick backsplash. The powder room and laundry are also on this floor. The spacious primary bedroom encompasses the entire top floor and has a stylish, elegant look with a king-size bed, a dresser with a flatscreen TV for nighttime viewing pleasure, and a sleek white armchair. This primary suite also has its own romantic veranda and a private bath with a walk-in shower. Besides the beach and lovely lake, this Seagrove Beach locale is near restaurants, friendly bars, shopping adventures, and delightful diversions. This idyllic retreat offers everything needed for a perfect coastal getaway. What time is it? It's five o'clock! First Floor: Bonus Den with Patio Access, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bunk Room with Two Full/Twin Bunks and Shared Tub/Shower Combo. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Powder Room with Laundry. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access. Based on the daily temperature and at the HOA's discretion, the community pool is typically heated October through April.
